reviews.title: No more Metallica????
reviews.text: Without warning all the Metallica content disappeared. Will not renew my subscription.

reviews.title: 6 string or bust.
reviews.text:
Kind of a jumbled mess. My friend and I have both experienced the app and it is great for them as a 6 string guitar player as a bass player I have learned more from YouTube and a $5 book at my local music store.

They talk a big game about having the rights to so many songs. Yeah but you don’t have the lyrics you have extremely stripped down versions of songs. Again a quick google search and I can find tabs better than what they are selling with the option to edit the backing to my choice and at the speed I can comfortable play at until I master it.

This app crashes like it gets paid for each time you have to close and open it. Don’t even think about switching your screen to say check a text or even look up what they are talking about in a lesson your play-along with because it will simply stop working.

Here is an idea Fender how about for your play alongs with the instructor you actually have the tabs scroll as you play that way you can actively in real time see your mistakes and correct them by rewinding the video instead of jumping between two separate videos hoping the app doesn’t crash?

Also why as an electric instrument player are you teaching me how to turn on my amp on after 20+ lessons of playing? I don’t mean edit your treble, mid, and bass to create new interesting sounds I mean how to flip on the power switch. Kind of sounds a bit disjointed doesn’t it?

The over all lesson structure feels like it was made by a hung over college music intern slapping together v

reviews.title: 8.0 Feedback Mode Mess
reviews.text:
Everything was working fine until the 8.0 release. Now previous scores are wiped, new 100% scores are shown as 1%, and some lessons cannot hear the notes at all, or claim that the wrong bass string(!) was played or the beat was off. There’s a lot of 0% scores from new lessons for me moving forward. I’m waiting for them to fix this mess which they do not openly acknowledge. Support explains the moving of Feedback
Mode, and advises to reinstall the app. What a crock!

reviews.title: Update screwed up the feedback mode
reviews.text: The latest update added feedback mode to practice mode. First problem is that it doesn’t record my score. The bigger problem is that I can no longer use AirPods for listening to the track and iPad microphone for listening to my playing. It is all either iPad or AirPod and AirPods only hear voice.  Notes aren’t recognized. This is a colossal screw up by fender.

reviews.title: 8.x Launch Is A Disaster
reviews.text: Launch of 8.X is a disaster! It deleted my progress history, high scores, and won’t even grade my performance any longer. I hope that Fender fixes the app soon.

reviews.title: What a waste
reviews.text: I downloaded this after using the Gibson app, because there seemed to be a better song list. After trying it, there is no live feedback or gamification of any of the songs. I don’t know why I would pay 150 a year to get tabs and video lessons only. I can get what this offers for free in tons of other resources. Oh well.

reviews.title: 7.4.5 will not work, closes every time
reviews.text: Downloaded nestest app version today on iPad OS 26.2.1. App thinks I am a new user and goes through the startup questions. On the fourth screen, “What path interests you right now?” the app closes. Have uninstalled and reinstalled, rebooted the iPad, tried multiple times but not able to start the app beyond those four screens. If this does not get fixed quickly I would like a refund.

reviews.title: Video issues
reviews.text: How difficult is it, in this day and age, to get full screen videos to work properly? If you play a video on full screen and then click X the video either starts from the beginning or plays two sets of audio at once. Annoying because it’s otherwise a decent app and course, but we are paying for this….

reviews.title: Confusing Billing
reviews.text: I hadn’t use the app in a while. After changing email address there was no way for me to sign in and recover my account.  Now I can’t cancel.  I can’t renew.  And I can’t access the app even though I have an active subscription.

reviews.title: Subscription problems
reviews.text: Used the app for a year and got some use out of it but felt there were better options else where so I tried to cancel my subscription. It charged me the next year even though I ensured I canceled my plan and just recent got charged again for a second time. Really annoying.

reviews.title: Not for beginners
